views.text: Downloads, synced lyrics, motion artwork, and library tools for Apple Music.

views.markdown: Add download buttons in Search and on supported artist, album, and playlist pages. Choose FLAC, MP3, or FLAC with MP3 fallback; skip tracks already in your library; and manage a multi-song queue with pause, resume, cancel, remove, and retry controls. Import audio files, folders, and M3U playlists, or match Spotify and Deezer links to Apple Music. Playlist links can create a playlist in your library.

Fetch timed lyrics for songs or your whole library, search manually, edit lyrics, and fine-tune their timing. Choose free LRCLIB or Musixmatch with your own token, and have lyrics open automatically in Now Playing. On compatible devices with iOS 16.2 or later, ByeTunes can enable Apple Music Sing's vocal slider.

Bring animated album covers to Now Playing. Choose the standard square motion cover or the immersive **iOS 26** style, which uses tall artwork and blends into the album's colors. Animation pauses in Low Power Mode.

Pin up to six favorite artists, albums, and playlists at the top of your Library. Build smart playlists and keep Loved, Most Played, Recently Played, and Top Rated playlists up to date. Import local music, fetch metadata and lyrics for playlists, show star ratings, clean up ghost entries, and repair sort order. Pinning includes iOS 16-specific Library list handling; playlist and maintenance database paths are included on iOS 16 but have less device verification than on iOS 15.
Reorder and choose which tabs appear, add a Downloads tab, filter search categories, choose a default search tab, and follow download or metadata progress with the status banner.

**iOS 15 and iOS 16**
Animated artwork, downloads, and interface tools support both versions. Timed lyrics use different Music integrations on iOS 15 and 16; the iOS 15 timed-lyrics hook is unavailable on arm64e devices. Apple Music Sing requires iOS 16.2+ and compatible hardware; this option is marked untested in the current project changelog.

**1.0 — Initial release**

**Downloads and imports**
- Download buttons in Search and on artist, album and playlist pages (FLAC, MP3, or FLAC with MP3 fallback)
- Download queue with progress; skips songs already in your library
- Import from Spotify and Deezer links, or from local files, folders and playlists
- Fetch metadata, covers and lyrics for songs, playlists or your whole library

**Lyrics**
- Time-synced lyrics from free LRCLIB or Musixmatch (your own token)
- Word-by-word lyrics: Apple Music's own on iOS 16.2 and newer, a tweak-drawn version on earlier iOS
- Manual lyrics search with Static, Synced and Word Synced results
- Lyrics editor and timing offset control; open lyrics automatically
- Apple Music Sing vocal slider on iOS 16.2 and newer

**Now Playing and artwork**
- Animated artwork, standard or full-screen iOS 26 style
- Love button in Now Playing

**Library and playlists**
- Pin up to six artists, albums and playlists to the top of your Library
- Loved, Most Played, Recently Played and smart playlists
- Duplicate finder, plus library repair tools

**Interface**
- Tab manager, Downloads tab, search filters and a default search tab
- Redesigned Settings

For iOS 15 and iOS 16, rootless jailbreaks.
